recent_posts.Post Message: "Knowledge without compassion is meaningless."   Our namesake, Dr. Albert Sabin, not only developed the oral polio vaccine — he also believed that everyone, everywhere deserved access to life-saving immunization. We are proud to support his legacy with our work.  Learn more about Dr. Sabin ⤵️ https://ow.ly/8gkS50ZcSoT

With 43 newly confirmed infections, U.S. measles cases have reached 2,073 as of Friday. Among all patients, 6% have needed to be hospitalized and 93% have been unvaccinated or have an unknown vaccination status.  Vaccines are the best protection against the disease, which not only can cause severe complications soon after exposure but can also generally weaken the immune system, causing it to "forget" how to fight infections and leaving children highly vulnerable.  More from Center for Infectious Disease Research and Policy (CIDRAP) on the rise in cases ⤵️ https://ow.ly/Zn4g50ZbVTH

💧 On #WorldEnvironmentDay, we focus on the many ways the environment supports global health, from the air we breathe to the water we drink.   A study in Nature earlier this year, for example, predicted that extreme weather events — such as floods that allow mosquito proliferation — could lead to 123 million additional malaria cases in Africa between 2024 and 2050, with 532,000 additional deaths.   While new vaccines are helping, reducing malaria and other diseases requires understanding the environment around us as well.

Marburg virus disease, a deadly hemorrhagic fever related to Ebola, has a fatality rate of up to 88%.  Sabin's cAd3-Marburg Vaccine was administered to more than 2,230 participants in Phase 2 clinical trials in an outbreak setting in Rwanda (2024) and Ethiopia (2025).   Learn more about our Marburg vaccine development program ⤵️ https://ow.ly/XA1Q50ZcJPf

board.public_perception_text: Sabin's social media presence continues to strengthen institutional reputation. Our messaging reaches diverse stakeholder groups with strong engagement metrics. Positive sentiment reflects public confidence in our vaccine research and immunization initiatives.
board.donor_engagement_text: Social channels serve as critical touchpoints for demonstrating research impact and organizational effectiveness. Quarterly reports of breakthrough achievements drive stakeholder engagement and support fundraising objectives. Expanding reach indicates growing influence in vaccine policy discussions.
board.risk_management_text: Consistent engagement monitoring identifies potential reputational risks early. Current positioning addresses vaccine concerns and establishes Sabin as trusted authority. Social media serves as early warning system enabling rapid response to misinformation.

assumptions: Reach and impressions are standardized into one visibility metric per platform, using impressions when available and otherwise reach.
Report-facing summary cards use Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn only so the dashboard and quarterly report share one scope.
Cross-network post engagements continue to come from Hootsuite's Post engagement aggregate, with X removed when legacy X totals are present.
Report-facing engagement totals stay aligned to Hootsuite's engagement definition and do not add link clicks on top.
Owly tracked-click exports are the report-facing website-resource click metric for Facebook and LinkedIn posts; X/Twitter Owly tables are optional when present.
YouTube follower counts remain available in raw Hootsuite exports, but report-facing summary cards exclude YouTube until a matching platform detail layer is maintained.
Actual follower pace uses real January 1 follower counts when they can be recovered from January exports or saved January dashboard artifacts.
Target pace remains a separate benchmark derived from the stated year-end target and annual growth rate.

Monthly export completeness is complete only when the cross-platform aggregate export, Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn full post-performance exports, and the expected Facebook/LinkedIn Owly website-click exports are present.
Email exports are excluded from social platform calculations to avoid mixing unlike metrics.
Follower pace is labeled slightly behind when actual performance is within 5% of the benchmark pace.

The cross-platform aggregate account_metrics export is the all-platform rollup, and supplemental top-post files may still be needed to support post-level context where full post-performance exports are missing.
